source: the instances committed in github.com/carlberton/sat-syndrome-decoding at commit 7177dc9fbae346b1dd997b61af6ad0208f7a35f2, which are the ones the authors produced for their FM 2026 paper. No competition published these formulas, so there is nothing in GBD to compare against: the hashes here are the ones gbdc computes on the authors' own files, and reproducing them is what the image is checked against.
